svg.text: Two-branch hierarchical Tesseract predictor with PoE late fusion (Phase 3, EXP-036) and an image-conditioned SO(3) flow posterior (Phase 4, EXP-042)

g.text: causal self-attn + cross-attn to M_A, 2 layers
cell token = level emb + Fourier(cell centre)

svg.text: train: cross-entropy per level with geodesic soft targets (synthetic train only)
input features standardised with train statistics

g.text: q ≡ −q: positive facet of max |qᵢ|; cube → sphere by radial projection

svg.text: Phase 4 — continuous posterior by Riemannian flow matching on SO(3) (EXP-042)

g.text: KDE mode (5° kernel); 90% region from sample spread
≈17 ms / image · only the flow heads are trained;
a = Log(R₀⁻¹R₁*), R_τ = R₀·Exp(τa), τ ~ U(0,1), 16 pairs / image
L_FM = ‖ω_θ(R_τ, τ | image) − a‖² (geodesic path, constant target)
R₁* = ground-truth rotation; pairs within 0.06° of the 180° cut locus are masked

svg.text: Rotation only, ground-truth crops. Selection on synthetic validation; lightbox / sunlamp (real) are test-only. The real-domain gain comes from PoE (lightbox: DINOv3 alone 37.1°, MoGe-2 alone 43.7°, PoE 26.9°).
Remaining real-domain error is dominated by ~180° body-axis flips caused by visual near-symmetry (EXP-104); the flow's best-of-32 shows the correct mode is usually among its samples.
